title: Posting kit: your voice doc and your first post
purpose: Your voice doc built from your own writing, then a first post drafted in that voice for you to make yours and post.
why: Picking what to post and getting it to sound like you are the hard parts. Your coach's drafter does both from your own week: you paste a few things you wrote, it builds your voice doc, then it drafts posts from what you actually did. You fill the brackets with what really happened and post.
evidence: Your voice doc saved and your first post live.

p: Noticed → why it matters → question. Something small you saw this week, what it says about the work, and a question you'd genuinely like answered.
Problem → decision → result. One decision in something you're building: what you chose, why, and what changed.
A comment, grown up. A pattern you keep seeing in other people's posts, credited, with your own angle added.
Every draft leaves square brackets where it needs a fact only you have. Fill each one with what really happened, cut anything that isn't true, and change any line that doesn't sound like you.
Bring what got replies to the next session: keep the shapes that work and drop the rest.

modules.title: Write posts that sound like you

tasks.title: Paste two or three things you wrote and check your voice doc
how: Paste posts, long messages or a paragraph from anything you wrote. Your own words work better than anything you'd write for this.
Read the voice doc it builds. Change anything that doesn't sound like you; drafts follow it.
tasks.done_when: Your voice doc is saved and reads like you.

tasks.title: Pick a draft, make it yours and post it
tasks.done_when: The post is live and every claim in it is something you did or saw.
